Name: (FF) Better Coffee
Author: FacuFu
Description:
[b]Mod: Better Coffee[/b]

[i]Tired of sipping weak coffee in Stardew Valley? Say goodbye to those barely-there energy boosts![/i]

This mod enhances the effects of [b]"Coffee"[/b] and [b]"Triple Shot Espresso"[/b], making them give you more energy, just like a real caffeine kick! Whether you're farming, mining, or exploring, now you can keep going with a little extra boost from your morning (or evening) brew.

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*]Increases the energy boost from "Coffee" and "Triple Shot Espresso".
[*]Perfect for players who want more stamina to enjoy the game longer.
[*]Simple and lightweight mod, easy to install and compatible with other mods.
[/list]

[b]Installation:[/b]
1. Download the mod file.
2. Place it in your [code]Mods[/code] folder.
3. Start your game and enjoy your improved coffee!

[i]Now, every sip counts![/i]

Manifest.Name: Better Coffee
Manifest.Description: Modifies the Coffee and Triple Shot Espresso energy values.
